Frequently Asked Questions

1. What types of properties are available for rent in Saudi Arabia?

Saudi Arabia offers a wide range of rental properties including apartments, villas, floors, and commercial spaces. Tenants can find options in all major cities like Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, and Mecca, depending on their needs for location, budget, and amenities.

2. Can expatriates rent properties in Saudi Arabia?

Yes, expats with a valid Iqama (residency permit) can legally rent homes or commercial units in Saudi Arabia. The Ejar platform is commonly used to register lease agreements and ensure compliance with the Ministry of Housing regulations.

3. What is the average rent for apartments and villas in major cities?

Rental prices vary by location. For instance, apartments in central Riyadh or Jeddah may start around SAR 25,000–40,000 annually, while villas in upscale neighborhoods can range from SAR 70,000 to SAR 200,000 depending on size and features.
